newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka retains early edge to end stronger.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka retains early edge to end stronger.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained early edge to end firmer at 42.5325/5375 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday compared with the previous close at 42.5350/5450, dealers said.
The taka quoted stronger at 42.5300/5450 per dollar in early trade and edged up further due to ample dollar supply.

Dealers said the U.S. currency was likely to remain under strain till end of the fasting month of Ramadan when imports were expected to pick up. "Poor presence of importers (in the market) is to blame for weakening of the dollar," one dealer said.
The interbank call money rates closed at 3.75 to 4.25 percent, down from Monday's 4.0-4.25 percent.
